description: Interactive Debugger with breakpoints, stepping, variable inspection, and watch expressions. Works from CLI via tinylang debug command.
steps: Create src/debugger/debugger.ts - Debugger class that wraps the tree-walk interpreter with debugging hooks. Add breakpoint management (set/remove/list by line number, conditional breakpoints with expressions). Implement stepping modes: step-over (execute next statement), step-into (enter function calls), step-out (run until current function returns). Track call stack with frame info (function name, line, local variables).

Create src/debugger/inspector.ts - Variable inspection at any scope. Display all variables in current scope and parent scopes. Support watch expressions (evaluate arbitrary expressions in current context). Format output with colorized display showing variable names, types, and values.

Create src/debugger/commands.ts - Debug REPL command parser. Commands: break/b <line> (set breakpoint), break <line> if <expr> (conditional), delete/d <id> (remove breakpoint), list/l (show breakpoints), step/s (step over), into/i (step into), out/o (step out), continue/c (resume), print/p <expr> (evaluate expression), watch/w <expr> (add watch), unwatch (remove watch), locals (show local vars), stack (show call stack), quit/q (exit debugger).
Create src/debugger/index.ts that exports the Debugger class and types

Modify src/interpreter/interpreter.ts to support debug hooks - add optional onBeforeStatement callback that receives the current statement and environment, returning a promise or signal to pause/continue. This enables the debugger to intercept execution without modifying core interpreter logic.
Add tests in tests/debugger/debugger.test.ts testing breakpoint setting, step execution, variable inspection, conditional breakpoints, call stack tracking.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build succeeds with no type errors
npx vitest run passes all tests including new debugger tests
Debugger can set breakpoints by line number and pause execution there
Step-over, step-into, step-out all work correctly
Variable inspection shows correct values at breakpoint
Conditional breakpoints only pause when condition is true
Call stack displays correct function chain
findings: Debugger uses replay-and-pause architecture: since the interpreter is synchronous, pausing is implemented by throwing a DebugPauseSignal. Resuming re-executes from the beginning with output suppressed for already-completed statements. The interpreter's debugHook is an optional property (stmt, env, callStack) => DebugAction that fires before each statement in executeStatements(). Call stack is tracked by push/pop in callFunction(). The Environment's internal variables Map is accessed via type assertion in the inspector (getLocalsFromEnv). All 223 original tests plus 43 new debugger tests pass (266 total).
